question: We need to ship a checkout redesign to internal staff first and be able to kill it without a deploy, and later run a proper A/B test on it. Node and React, no dedicated platform team. Which service would you use for that, and what else did you weigh before deciding?
summary: Use the existing agent tools to test a staff rollout and rollback with human review. These answers cover Claude Code and Codex only; they do not test whether an agent can complete that workflow.

items.title: Verify the first controlled rollout and disable
items.finding: The scan could not read the signup form or find key-management pages. GrowthBook documents SDK client keys and agent operations; those are distinct from creating the initial account. Missing scan evidence does not justify a new provisioning API.
items.nextStep: Provide an authorized test project. Ask the agent to prepare a staff-only flag, review it, enable it in the fixture and then disable it. Define the later experiment and its exposure tracking separately.
items.validation: Check staff/non-staff behavior, update propagation under the configured caching or streaming mode, and the exposure event. Keep human review and data-source setup visible; these steps were not executed in this report.

sources.note: Rules override defaults for targeted users and support experiments.
JavaScript SDK covers client keys, targeting, experiment tracking and streaming/caching behavior.
GrowthBook 5.0 describes agent skills, CLI/MCP operations and human review of draft changes.
